headline: China Grants Citigroup Approval for Wholly-Owned Securities Unit
summary: China has granted Citigroup approval to establish a wholly-owned securities company, marking another step in the country's financial market opening-up push.
why: Allowing foreign financial institutions full ownership of local securities operations expands access to China's domestic capital markets.

impacts.name: Citigroup
impacts.why: Wholly-owned local operations allow the bank to expand its business footprint in Chinese capital markets.
